# live-mix, the part the jam uses

Generated by `scripts/vendor-live-mix.mjs` from the commit of [live-mix](https://github.com/kieranklaassen/live-mix) named in `COMMIT`, under its MIT license. Only `package.json`, the two `.d.ts` files and this page are written by hand.

- `core/` is the engine: tracks, the transport, the clip scheduler, buses and the ducker, on plain Web Audio nodes.
- `dsp/` plays a phrase on an instrument without an audio context, in a worker. It is live-mix's `renderPatch` with a registry of the devices in the script's `DEVICES` and no others, which is about 95 KB where the whole one is 1.5 MB.
- `wasm/` is those instruments and the plate reverb. A browser gets only the ones a game plays.

An AudioWorklet runs only on an https page or localhost. `renderPatch` needs none, so music made with it also plays on the iPad that opens a jam served over http on the home network.
